parsed.claim_reason: Monotonicity only gives q_k <= q_1; it imposes no positive lower bound. A nonincreasing sequence of positive reals starting above 1 may drop to 1 or below, so the conclusion q_k > 1 for all k does not follow.
parsed.witness_reason: All terms are positive reals, q_1 = 2 > 1, and 2 >= 1 >= 1 >= ... is nonincreasing, satisfying every hypothesis; yet q_2 = 1 is not greater than 1, violating the conclusion.
